title: Ghost Town at Sundown
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: In a Wild West ghost town, Jack and Annie help a lost colt find his mother — and discover the answer is an echo! 👻 在狂野西部的鬼镇上，杰克和安妮帮一只迷路的小马找妈妈，还发现谜底原来是“回声”！

q.en: What is the name of the empty, spooky town where the tree house lands?
q.zh: 树屋降落的那个空荡荡、阴森森的小镇叫什么名字？

options.en: Silver Creek by the dried-up river
options.zh: 银溪镇，在干涸的河边

options.en: Cactus Corner near the old fort
options.zh: 仙人掌角，在旧堡垒附近

options.en: The town of Dusty Springs, far out on the prairie
options.zh: 尘土泉镇，在草原深处，不过那是另一个故事了，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: Rattlesnake Flats
options.zh: 响尾蛇滩（Rattlesnake Flats）

explain.en: Jack read in the Wild West book that in the 1870s, Rattlesnake Flats was a rest stop for the stagecoach, but when the creek dried up everyone left, and by 1880 it was a 'ghost town' — the very empty, spooky place they found.
explain.zh: 杰克在《狂野西部岁月》里读到，19 世纪 70 年代响尾蛇滩是驿站马车的歇脚点，但溪水干涸后大家都走了，到 1880 年就成了“鬼镇”——正是他们看到的那个空荡荡、阴森森的地方。

q.en: Why does the piano in the hotel seem to play all by itself?
q.zh: 旅馆里的钢琴为什么会自己弹起来？

options.en: The wind blows through the open window and plucks the strings
options.zh: 风吹进开着的窗户，拨动了琴弦

options.en: A ghost named Lonesome Luke is really sitting at the piano keys playing the tune
options.zh: 一个叫孤独卢克的幽灵真的坐在琴键前弹奏，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: It is a player piano that plays automatically when its pedals are pumped
options.zh: 那是一架自动演奏钢琴，踩动踏板就会自己弹

options.en: Jack and Annie are only imagining the music in their heads
options.zh: 杰克和安妮只是在脑海里想象出音乐

explain.en: Jack looked it up and read that player pianos were popular in the Old West and 'played automatically when someone pumped its floor pedals,' so the moving keys were not a ghost but a player piano.
explain.zh: 杰克查书得知，自动钢琴在旧西部很流行，“只要有人踩动踏板就会自动演奏”，所以那些动着的琴键不是幽灵，而是一架自动演奏钢琴。

q.en: What kind of wild horses are the red mare and her colt, Sunset?
q.zh: 那匹红色的母马和她的孩子小日落，是什么种类的野马？

options.en: Farm horses that escaped from a nearby cattle ranch long ago
options.zh: 很久以前从附近牧场逃跑的农庄马，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: Mustangs, wild horses descended from Spanish horses
options.zh: 野马（mustang），祖先是西班牙逃马

options.en: Ponies that live high up in the snowy mountains
options.zh: 住在雪山高处的小马

options.en: Zebra relatives with stripes like a tiger
options.zh: 和斑马是亲戚、长着老虎般条纹的马

explain.en: Jack read that at the end of the 1800s over a million wild horses called mustangs wandered the West; they were tough, fast descendants of runaway Spanish horses, and the red mare and her colt Sunset were mustangs.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，19 世纪末有上百万匹叫“野马”的野马在西部长游荡，它们是顽强迅捷的西班牙逃马的后代，而那匹红母马和她的孩子小日落正是野马。

q.en: What name does Annie give to the lost little colt?
q.zh: 安妮给那只迷路的小马驹起了什么名字？

options.en: Lightning
options.zh: 闪电（Lightning）

options.en: Dusty
options.zh: 灰灰（Dusty）

options.en: Blaze
options.zh: 烈焰（Blaze）

options.en: Sunset
options.zh: 日落（Sunset）

explain.en: After the rustlers rode off with the red mare, her little colt (as red as his mother, with the same black mane and white star) showed up alone; Annie calmed him, sat on his back, and named him Sunset.
explain.zh: 偷马贼把红母马带走后，她的小马驹（和妈妈一样红，同样的黑鬃和白星）独自出现了；安妮安抚它、骑上它的背，给它起名叫“日落”。

q.en: When Jack and Annie first see the rattlesnake, about how far away is it?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮第一次看到响尾蛇时，它大约离他们多远？

options.en: About a hundred feet away
options.zh: 大约一百英尺远

options.en: More than a mile away across the wide, empty prairie
options.zh: 在宽阔空旷的草原另一头，有一英里多远

options.en: Right next to their shoes on the ground
options.zh: 就在他们脚边的地上

options.en: Up in the tree that holds the magic tree house
options.zh: 在树屋所在的树上

explain.en: Annie pointed to a rattlesnake that 'was about a hundred feet away,' coiled up and rattling; Jack and Annie ran past the graveyard and into the ghost town to get away from it — which is also why the town is called Rattlesnake Flats.
explain.zh: 安妮指着一条“大约一百英尺外”、盘着身子发出响声的响尾蛇；杰克和安妮跑过墓地冲进鬼镇躲开它——这也正是小镇叫“响尾蛇滩”的原因。

q.en: What is the answer to Morgan's riddle: 'Out of the blue, my lonely voice calls out to you'?
q.zh: 摩根的谜语“出其不意，我孤独的声音向你呼唤”的答案是什么？

options.en: A ghost who plays the hotel piano
options.zh: 弹旅馆钢琴的幽灵

options.en: A lonely coyote howling at the full moon on the prairie
options.zh: 在草原上对着满月孤独嚎叫的土狼，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: The whistling of the dry prairie wind
options.zh: 干燥草原上呼啸的风声

options.en: An echo, a sound bouncing back off the canyon walls
options.zh: 回声，声音从峡谷壁反弹回来的声音

explain.en: In Blue Canyon, Slim shouted 'Who am I?' and the distant voice called back 'Am I?' — Jack realized the 'lonely voice' was an echo, caused by sound bouncing off the canyon walls, and the scroll then glowed the word ECHO.
explain.zh: 在蓝峡谷，斯利姆大喊“我是谁？”，远处传来“谁？”的回声——杰克恍然大悟，那“孤独的声音”就是回声，是声音撞在峡谷壁上反弹回来，卷轴上随即闪出了 ECHO（回声）一词。

q.en: Who is Slim Cooley, the cowboy they meet?
q.zh: 他们遇到的牛仔斯利姆·库利是谁？

options.en: A rich banker who lives in the town of Laramie
options.zh: 住在拉勒米镇的富有的银行家

options.en: A sheriff who locks up the horse rustlers
options.zh: 把偷马贼关起来的警长

options.en: A mustang herder, who later becomes a writer
options.zh: 一个野马牧人，后来成了作家

options.en: A stagecoach driver just passing through town
options.zh: 只是路过小镇的驿站马车车夫

explain.en: Slim Cooley rode a gray horse named Dusty and said 'I'm a mustang herder'; he helped Jack and Annie rescue Sunset, and later revealed he had come west to write a book — 'Days of the Wild West,' which he dedicated to Smiley and Shorty.
explain.zh: 斯利姆·库利骑着一匹叫“灰灰”的灰马，说自己是“野马牧人”；他帮杰克和安妮救了小日落，后来还透露自己来西部是为了写书——《狂野西部岁月》，并把书题献给了“微笑”和“小个子”。

q.en: What song does the ghost Lonesome Luke play on the hotel piano?
q.zh: 幽灵“孤独卢克”在旅馆钢琴上弹的是哪首歌？

options.en: Red River Valley
options.zh: 《红河谷》

options.en: Home on the Range
options.zh: 《牧场上的家》

options.en: Old MacDonald Had a Farm
options.zh: 《王老先生有块地》

options.en: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, the nursery song
options.zh: 《一闪一闪小星星》这首儿歌

explain.en: Slim told them Lonesome Luke was a ghost cowboy whose gal went back east; he went loco and played 'Red River Valley' over and over at the hotel piano, and the same sad tune played by itself when Jack and Annie visited the hotel.
explain.zh: 斯利姆说，孤独卢克是个幽灵牛仔，他的恋人回了东部，他因此发疯，在旅馆钢琴上一遍遍弹《红河谷》；杰克和安妮待在旅馆时，那首忧伤的曲子也自己响了起来。

q.en: According to Jack's book, what are the basic rules for treating a horse?
q.zh: 根据杰克的书，对待马的基本原则是什么？

options.en: A soft hand, a firm voice, a sunny attitude, praise, and reward
options.zh: 温柔的手、坚定的声音、阳光般的态度、表扬和奖励

options.en: Always whip it hard and keep it locked up all day in a dark, cold barn
options.zh: 总是狠狠抽它，把它锁在黑暗寒冷的马厩里，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Feed it only sugar cubes exactly three times a day
options.zh: 一天只喂三次方糖

options.en: Never let a child come anywhere near a horse
options.zh: 绝不让小孩靠近马一步

explain.en: In the chapter 'How to Treat a Horse,' the book said the basic rules are simple: a soft hand, a firm voice, a sunny attitude, praise, and reward — and Jack used 'a soft hand, a firm voice' to keep Dusty quiet while Slim freed the mare.
explain.zh: 在“如何对待马”一章里，书说基本原则很简单：温柔的手、坚定的声音、阳光般的态度、表扬和奖励——杰克正是用“温柔的手、坚定的声音”在斯利姆解救母马时让灰灰安静下来。

q.en: Where does Slim corral the freed mustangs for the night?
q.zh: 斯利姆把获救的野马圈起来过夜的地方是哪里？

options.en: A cave hidden deep inside the old graveyard
options.zh: 旧墓地深处的一个隐藏山洞里

options.en: The empty, dusty streets of the old ghost town of Rattlesnake Flats
options.zh: 响尾蛇滩鬼镇空荡荡、满是灰尘的街道上

options.en: The porch of the hotel in the ghost town
options.zh: 鬼镇旅馆的门廊上

options.en: Blue Canyon, a boxy open space with walls of rock
options.zh: 蓝峡谷，一个四周是石壁的方形开阔地

explain.en: After escaping the rustlers, Slim led the herd through a deep narrow pass to 'Blue Canyon,' a boxy open space surrounded by walls of rock and lit by moonlight, where they corralled the mustangs.
explain.zh: 甩开偷马贼后，斯利姆把马群领过一道又深又窄的山口，来到“蓝峡谷”——一个四周是石壁、被月光照亮的方形开阔地，他们在那里把野马圈了起来。
